adaptation: AGC ring and driver counter layout, DCE ioctl query and rolling/multipass interpretation. TacHen adds generation-bound guarded worker reads, per-page translation, explicit display-rate fallback, optional shared sampling and independent menu/metric sequences. No cached physical mappings, old HEN marker files or sampling daemon are carried over.

sdk.use: Linked kernel_proc_getpaddr page translation; TacHen performs its own bounded physical reads. The generic process-copy fallback is not used by telemetry.
